prompt: A parallelogram has base $9$ in and height $4$ in. What is its **area** in square inches?
hint: Area of a parallelogram is $\text{base} \times \text{height}$, just like a rectangle.
explanation: Use the formula: Area $= b \times h$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Cut and rearrange
steps: Cut a right triangle off one end of the parallelogram.
Slide it to the other end to make a **rectangle** with the same base and height.
Rectangle area $= 9 \times 4 = 36$ sq in — so the parallelogram's area is also $36$.
